sources.title: amsterdamcream - Tumblr blog | Tumgik
sources.excerpt: ORIGINAL DISTORTION. The Original Distortion captures an old full tube amp again. A high quality carbon composition resistor is used for a better sound. It gives a bluesy, vintage, and rich feel with low gain while it gives a full, deep, and strong sound with high gain. The Original Distortion has a very high volume. Specifications: Control Volume, Distortion. Size 91x38x30mm. True Bypass. Hand Made in Korea.
